ruleContent.content:
<js>
let d = JSON.parse(result);

let limit = Number(baseUrl.match(/limit=(\d+)/)[1]);


let commentTotal  =  Number(java.getString("$.data.commentTotal"));

let page = Math.ceil(commentTotal/limit);

let p = (Number(baseUrl.match(/offset=(\d+)/)[1])/limit)+1;

function getPlainText(cl) {
    let output = "";
    let cllen = cl.length;
    let sss = String(source.getVariable());
    let re = /^([\[\]橘糖紫糖]|嗑到了|kswl|\[.*?\]|\d+\.\d+\.\d+|.刷|打卡|\s)+$|为营造更好的评论环境，/;
    let sre = sss.match(/屏蔽【(.*?)】/)?.[1] ?? null;
    sre = sre ? new RegExp(sre.replace(/,/g, '|'), 'g') : null;    
    let plen = 0;
    let validCount = 0;

    for (let i in cl) {
        let c = cl[i];
        let reply = (c?.replyAll ?? c?.reply);
        let rl = [];

        // 跳过屏蔽内容
        if (re.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) : null)) {
            cllen--;
            plen++;
            continue;
        }

        // 处理回复
        for (let j in reply) {
            let r = reply[j];
            if (re.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) : null)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            let authorTag = r?.isAuthor === "1" ? "👑" : "📜";
            
            rl.push({
                text: `${authorTag} ${r.replyAuthor ?? r.commentauthor} (${(!r.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(r.comment_date_time *1000)) ?? (r.replyDate || r.commentdate)})\n ${replaceEmoticons(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody)}`
            });
        }
        // 构建主评论
        let authorTag = "";
        if (c?.isAuthor === "1") {
            authorTag = "👑";
        } else if (c?.bulletinComment === "1") {
            authorTag = "📢";
        } else {
            authorTag = "👤";
        }

        // 主评论头部信息（作者、时间、订阅、互动数据）
        
        
        let header = `${authorTag} ${c.commentAuthor ?? c.commentauthor} `;
        let time = ` 📆${(!c.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(c.comment_date_time * 1000)) ?? (c.commentDate || c.commentdate || '')}`
        // 订阅信息
        
        if (c.subscriptionicon) {
            if (c.subscriptionrate) {
                header += ` 📖${c.subscriptionrate}`;
            } else if (c.subscriptionicon.includes("rate_novelallbuy")) {
                header += ` 📖100%`;
            }
        }

        // 互动数据
        header += ` \n👍${c.agreenum ?? "0"}`;
        if (c.commentMark) header += ` ⭐️${c.commentMark}`;
        
        output += "\n"+header + time+ "\n";
        output += `${replaceEmoticons(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody)}`;

        // 回复内容
        if (rl.length > 0) {
            output += "\n‎\n🔁 回复内容:\n";
            rl.forEach(reply => {
                output += `  ${reply.text}\n`;
            });
        }

        output += "\n‎\n";
        validCount++;
    }

    // 添加统计信息
    let stats = `🏷本章共有${commentTotal}条评论 | 共有${page}页\n💬当前第${p}页显示 ${validCount} 条评论 | 屏蔽 ${plen} 条评论`;
      
    return stats + "\n\n" + output;
}
let msg = d?.data.commentTotal?null:d.message;
if(msg){
	java.toast(msg);
}else{
result = getPlainText(d.data.commentList);
if(/\d+-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     if(/offset=0/.test(baseUrl)&&!/1-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     	result = ""
     	}
}
result.replace(/</g,'<')
.replace(/>/g,'>')
}
</js>

	let offset = (i-1)*limit;
list.push(
	baseUrl.replace(/offset=0/,'offset='+offset)
	);
}
return list
	}

}

ruleContent.nextContentUrl:
<js>
(function(){
    // 使用正则检测分页标签
    const hasNextLink = /<a\s+rel=\"next\"\s+class=\"next\"[^>]*>下—页<\/a>/i.test(result);
    if (!hasNextLink) return '';
    
    try {
        // 动态生成分页URL（适配数字型URL）
        let url = baseUrl;
        const pageMatch = url.match(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/);
        if (!pageMatch) return '';
        
        const [_, baseId, currentPage] = pageMatch;
        const pageNum = currentPage ? parseInt(currentPage) : 1;
        
        // 安全限制（最大3页）
        if (pageNum > 2) return ''; // 第3页后停止
        
        // 生成新URL（如 /123_2.html → /123_3.html）
        return url.replace(/(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?\.html$/, `${baseId}_${pageNum + 1}.html`);
    } catch(e) {
        return '';
    }
})()
</js>

}
li.sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)

var key = java.get('key');
var page = java.get('page');
var cookieHost = java.getCookie("https://masiro.me");

var headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/138.0.0.0",
    "Referer": "https://masiro.me/admin/novels",
    "Connection": "keep-alive",
    "Cookie": cookieHost || "",
    "X-XSRF-TOKEN": getCookieValue(cookieHost, "XSRF-TOKEN")
};
java.put('searchHeaders', headers);

var url = "https://masiro.me/admin/loadMoreNovels?page=" + page + 
		"&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) +
		"&_t=" + Date.now();

var response = java.get(url, headers);
var responseData = JSON.parse(response.body());

if (responseData.code !== 1) {
    java.error("请求失败: " + responseData.msg);
}

var resultList = [];
responseData.novels.forEach(function(novel) {
    var tags = [];
    novel.tags.forEach(function(tag) {
        tags.push(tag.name);
    });

    var translators = [];
    novel.translators.forEach(function(translator) {
        translators.push(translator.name);
    });

    var coverUrl = "https://masiro.me" + novel.cover_img;

    var novelItem = {
        id: novel.id,
        title: novel.title,
        brief: novel.brief,
        author: novel.author,
        cover: coverUrl,
        status: novel.status, // 0=连载中, 1=已完结
        wordCount: novel.words,
        updateTime: novel.updated_at,
        latestChapter: novel.new_up_content,
        tags: tags.join(", "),
        translators: translators.join(", "),
        readCount: novel.read_num,
        collectCount: novel.collect_nums,
        likeCount: novel.thumb_up,
        sourceUrl: novel.original
    };
    
    resultList.push(novelItem);
});

java.log(JSON.stringify(resultList));
result = resultList;
</js>

            if (introElement) {
                introText = introElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = introText;                 
                book.kind = null; 
                if (!introText.startsWith("简介:")) {
                    var kindPrefix = "类别:";
                    var kindIndex = introText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                    if (kindIndex !== -1) {
                        var kindTemp = introText.substring(kindIndex + kindPrefix.length).trim();
                        var chapterPrefix = "最新章节"; 
                        var chapterIndex = kindTemp.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                        if (chapterIndex !== -1) {
                            book.kind = kindTemp.substring(0, chapterIndex).trim(); 
                        } else {
                            book.kind = kindTemp; 
                        }
                    } else {
                        //java.log("未在 intro 文本中找到 '类别:' 用于提取 kind: " + introText);
                    }
                } else {
                    //java.log("intro 文本以 '简介:' 开头，kind 设为 null");
                }
            } else {
                book.intro = null; 
                book.kind = null;
                //java.log("未找到 intro/kind 对应的 div.text_2NOr6 标签");
            }            
            var allAElements = container.select("a");
            if (allAElements.size() >= 2) {
                book.lastChapter = allAElements.get(allAElements.size() - 2).text().trim();
            } else {
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                //java.log("a 标签数量不足，无法提取倒数第二个作为 lastChapter");
            }
        } else if (container.hasClass("result")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " (result)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;            
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                   //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var contentRightElement = container.selectFirst(".content-right_1THTn");
            if (contentRightElement) {
                var fullText = contentRightElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = fullText;                 
                book.author = null; 
                var authorPrefix = "作者:"; 
                var authorIndex = fullText.indexOf(authorPrefix);
                var kindSeparator = "类别"; 
                var kindIndexForAuthor = fullText.indexOf(kindSeparator);
                if (authorIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = authorIndex + authorPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (kindIndexForAuthor !== -1 && kindIndexForAuthor > authorIndex) ? kindIndexForAuthor : fullText.length;
                    book.author = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '作者:'");
                }                
                book.kind = null; 
                var kindPrefix = "类别:"; 
                var kindIndex = fullText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                var chapterSeparator = "最新章节"; 
                var chapterIndexForKind = fullText.indexOf(chapterSeparator);
                if (kindIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = kindIndex + kindPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (chapterIndexForKind !== -1 && chapterIndexForKind > kindIndex) ? chapterIndexForKind : fullText.length;
                    book.kind = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '类别:'");
                }                
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                var chapterPrefix = "最新章节:"; 
                var chapterIndex = fullText.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                var updateSeparator = "最新更新"; 
                var updateIndex = fullText.indexOf(updateSeparator);

                if (chapterIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = chapterIndex + chapterPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (updateIndex !== -1 && updateIndex > chapterIndex) ? updateIndex : fullText.length;
                    book.lastChapter = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '最新章节:'");
                }
            } else {                
                book.author = null;
                book.kind = null;
                book.lastChapter = null;
                book.intro = null;
                //java.log("未找到 .content-right_1THTn 元素");
            }
        } else {
            //java.log("跳过未知类型的容器: " + container.outerHtml().substring(0, 100));
            continue; 
        }        
        bookList.push(book);
    }
    var finalResult = {
        bookList: bookList 
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(finalResult);
} catch (e) {
    java.log("错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify({
        bookList: []
    }); 
}
result = finalJsonOutput;

function atob(input) {
/*正文解密by: Yolo。写源解密js不易，禁止转载！*/
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/='; 
  let str = String(input).replace(/=+$/, '');
  let output = '';  
  for (let bc = 0, bs = 0, buffer, i = 0; buffer = str.charAt(i++); ~buffer && (bs = bc % 4 ? bs * 64 + buffer : buffer, bc++ % 4) ? output += String.fromCharCode(255 & bs >> (-2 * bc & 6)) : 0) {
    buffer = chars.indexOf(buffer);
  }
  return output;
}

function decodeStr(arr) {
    var result = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        result += String.fromCharCode(arr[i]);
    }
    return decodeURIComponent(escape(result));
}

function de(str) {
    return str.split('').reverse().join('');
}

function decode(s, k, y) {
    var K = atob(k).split('').map(char => char.charCodeAt(0));
    var eK = de(K.map(char => String.fromCharCode(char)).join('')).split('').map(char => char.charCodeAt(0));
    var S = atob(y + s).split('').map(char => char.charCodeAt(0));
    var g = S.map((h, i) => h ^ eK[i % eK.length]);
    return decodeStr(g);
}

var nextChapterUrl = null; 
try {    
    var doc = result;
    if (!doc) {        
        throw new Error("HTML 解析失败"); 
    }        
    var nextLink = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(doc).select("a:containsOwn(下─章)");
    if (nextLink) {        
        var onclickValue = nextLink.attr("onclick");
        if (onclickValue) {                        
            var idRegex = /location\.href='([^']+)\.idx'/;
            var idMatch = onclickValue.match(idRegex);
            if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
                var chapterIdPart = idMatch[1];                 
                var checkRegex = /_\d+$/; 
                if (checkRegex.test(chapterIdPart)) {                                      
                    var newFileName = chapterIdPart + ".html";                                        
                    var lastSlashRegex = /\/[^/]*$/;
                    if (typeof baseUrl === 'string') {                        
                        nextChapterUrl = baseUrl.replace(lastSlashRegex, "/" + newFileName);
                        
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
} catch (e) {    
    nextChapterUrl = null; 
}
result = nextChapterUrl;

<js>
var datax = null;
var allChapters = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
var inputString = baseUrl;
var parts = inputString.split(',');
var url = parts[0].trim();
try {
    var xDataRegex = /x-data="[^"]*Login\(\d+,\s*'([^']+)'/;
    var match = result.match(xDataRegex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
        datax = match[1];
    } else {
        java.log("未能从源码中匹配并提取到 x-data token");
        throw new Error("XSRF token not found"); // Token 是必须的
    }
    var urlWithXsrf = url + "?_xsrf=" + encodeURIComponent(datax);
    var cookie = "85_ID=" + java.getCookie(url, "85_ID");
    var baseHeaders = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; 2312DRAABC) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/132.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
        "Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
        "Referer": url,
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain",
        "Cookie": cookie
    };
    var slices = [];
    var selectContentRegex = /<select class="[^"]*select-primary[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/select>/;
    var selectMatch = result.match(selectContentRegex);
    if (selectMatch && selectMatch[1]) {
        var optionsHtml = selectMatch[1];
        var sliceRegex = /(\d+)\s*~\s*(\d+)/g;
        var sliceMatch;
        while ((sliceMatch = sliceRegex.exec(optionsHtml)) !== null) {
            var start = parseInt(sliceMatch[1], 10);
            var end = parseInt(sliceMatch[2], 10);
            if (!isNaN(start) && !isNaN(end)) {
                slices.push([start, end]);
            }
        }
    }
    if (slices.length === 0) {
        java.log("未能提取到任何章节 Slice，将尝试获取默认范围 [1, 200]");
        slices = [
            [1, 200]
        ];
    }
    java.log("将要处理的 Slices: " + JSON.stringify(slices));
    for (var i = 0; i < slices.length; i++) {
        var currentSlice = slices[i];
        // java.log("准备获取 Slice: " + currentSlice.join(' ~ '));
        var maxAttempts = 3;
        var success = false;
        for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
            java.log("尝试获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts + " 次)");
            var jsonString = null;
            try {
                var bodyPayload = {
                    "action": "chapters",
                    "slice": currentSlice
                };
                var op = {
                    "body": JSON.stringify(bodyPayload),
                    "method": "post",
                    "headers": baseHeaders
                };
                var requestString = urlWithXsrf + "," + JSON.stringify(op);
                jsonString = java.ajax(requestString);
                if (jsonString && (jsonString.trim().startsWith('{') || jsonString.trim().startsWith('['))) {
                    var jsonObject = JSON.parse(jsonString);
                    if (jsonObject && jsonObject.result && Array.isArray(jsonObject.result.chapters)) {
                        var fetchedCount = jsonObject.result.chapters.length;
                        allChapters = allChapters.concat(jsonObject.result.chapters);
                        // java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试): 本次获取 " + fetchedCount + " 章, 累计 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                        java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试)");
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 的 JSON 响应格式不正确或未包含 chapters 数组: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    }
                } else {
                    java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 返回的不是有效的 JSON: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    java.log("Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " Raw Response (Attempt " + attempt + "): " + jsonString);
                }
            } catch (ajaxOrParseError) {
                java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试获取或解析 Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 时出错: " + ajaxOrParseError);
            }
            if (!success && attempt < maxAttempts) {
                var retryDelay = 4000;
                java.log("等待 " + retryDelay + "ms 后重试...");

                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(retryDelay);
            } else if (!success && attempt === maxAttempts) {

                java.log("已达到最大尝试次数 (" + maxAttempts + ")，放弃获取 Slice 重新搜索过下cf试试" + currentSlice.join('~'));
            }
        }
        if (i < slices.length - 1) {
            java.log("等待2500ms");
            Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(2500);
        }
    }
    var combinedResult = {
        "code": 0,
        "result": {
            "code": 1,
            "chapters": allChapters
        }
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(combinedResult);

} catch (e) {
    java.log("处理目录 JS 规则时发生顶层错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = null;
}
result = finalJsonOutput; 
</js>
